description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You critically hit your Marked quarry with a Strike, and your Feral Bond is within 30 feet of it and able to act.

Your Feral Bond gets an immediate bonus attack when you critically hit your Marked quarry.

Your Feral Bond immediately makes one Strike against your Marked quarry. This Strike does not count toward your Bond's actions on its own turn, and its multiple attack penalty is calculated separately from yours.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'). This card's real blocker is independent and unaffected by the Mark's existence: granting a companion an extra Strike triggered by the holder's own crit is a companion-action-economy grant -- no rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet (confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem, Ranger/Druid, where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too).
